title: Concord: A Video Relational Algebra for Cross-Modal Query Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2609.05756v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Semantic video queries let users embed natural language prompts and use multimodal large language models (MLLMs) to interpret the video. Such queries are increasingly popular for querying video data. However, their expressiveness comes at a steep cost: an MLLM may process hours of media to return only seconds of relevant output, making naive execution slow, expensive, and inaccurate.   We propose Concord, a system for expressing and optimizing semantic video queries. We makes three contributions. First, we introduce Video Relational Algebra (VRA), a nested algebra over videos, transcripts, frames, and object tracks that captures common semantic video operations. Second, we derive a set of approximate optimizations that rewrite VRA queries to reduce MLLM usage while improving result quality. translated_title: Concord：一种用于跨模态查询优化的视频关系代数
translated_abstract: 语义视频查询允许用户嵌入自然语言提示，并利用多模态大语言模型（MLLM）来解读视频。此类查询在视频数据查询中日益流行。然而，其表达能力伴随着高昂的代价：一个MLLM可能需要处理数小时的媒体内容才能返回仅几秒钟的相关输出，这使得朴素的执行方式缓慢、昂贵且不准确。我们提出了Concord，一个用于表达和优化语义视频查询的系统。我们做出了三项贡献。首先，我们引入了视频关系代数（VRA），这是一种作用于视频、转录文本、帧和对象轨迹的嵌套代数，能够捕捉常见的语义视频操作。其次，我们推导出一组近似优化方法，通过重写VRA查询来减少MLLM的使用，同时提高结果质量。对于带有解说的视频，Concord要么直接处理转录文本而非视频，要么利用转录文本来识别需要MLLM处理的视频片段。对于跨摄像（原文在此截断）
tldr: 本文提出Concord系统，创新性地引入视频关系代数（VRA）以及一组近似查询优化方法，通过利用转录文本替代或筛选视频片段供MLLM处理，在大幅降低多模态大语言模型调用开销的同时提升了语义视频查询的结果质量。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Concord, a system that introduces a Video Relational Algebra (VRA) and a set of approximate query optimizations that leverage transcripts to replace or filter video processing, significantly reducing MLLM usage while improving the quality and efficiency of semantic video queries.
